review:
Money Stacks Megaways mixes 117,649 ways and tumbling reels with collect symbols. A Collect on reel one or six awards every money symbol on the grid, and Super Collects add extra money symbols to reels that already have some. Two collectors at once apply a random 2x–10x multiplier.

Three to six scatters let you choose a bonus. Random Wild Multipliers gives 7–15 free spins and a random boost, with each tumble adding 1x and wilds carrying 2x–5x. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 10,000x. The RTP is 96.52%. Having a bonus choice adds a layer of strategy.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
